topic: Fundamentals of Linear Algebra: Understanding Vectors

sections.title: Introduction: What is a Vector?
lecture_lines: Vectors are directed arrows in space.
They represent both magnitude and direction.
Unlike scalars, vectors have multiple components.
animations: Create a 2D arrow representing a vector v with label #FFFFFF.
Fade in a coordinate system background in #222222.
Highlight vector v in #FF5733 to show its magnitude.

sections.title: Vector Addition: The Head-to-Tail Rule
lecture_lines: Place the second vector's tail at the head.
The resultant is the total displacement.
animations: Draw two vectors u and v with labels in #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pencil.svg].
Shift v to start at the head of u using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg].
Draw resultant vector u+v in #00FF00 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/protractor.svg].

sections.title: Scalar Multiplication: Scaling the Arrow
lecture_lines: Scalars change a vector's length or direction.
Multiplying by a scalar scales the vector.
Negative scalars reverse the vector's direction.
animations: Scale vector v by 2, changing length to 2v.
Change color of 2v to #FFFF00 for emphasis. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: Basis Vectors: The Building Blocks
lecture_lines: Basis vectors i and j are building blocks.
Any vector is their linear combination.
animations: Show unit vectors i and j in #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Demonstrate scaling i and j for vector coordinates.
Visualize vector (x,y) as combination xi + yj [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg].

sections.title: Application and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Vectors are essential in computer graphics.
They model physical forces in physics.
Magnitude, direction, and combinations are key.
animations: Summarize vector addition and scalar multiplication concepts using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/computer.svg].
Display final vector application example in #00FFFF on a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/monitor.svg].
Fade out all visual elements smoothly.
